requirements.ask_text: In what year were you born?

source.text: 1. dogum_yili: "In what year were you born?" Format year: exactly four digits.
2. ilce: "What is your registered district?" Format text: trim outer whitespace, preserve internal spaces.

requirements.ask_text: What is your six-digit security number?

source.text: 3. guvenlik_sayisi: "What is your six-digit security number?" Format digits: exactly six, preserve leading zeros.

identity.failed_instruction: Please verify your identity at a Selvi branch.

source.text: Ask at most twice, answering questions before repeating. Still unclear: ulasilmadi/belirsiz. ... No question has a recoverable format-hint exception. TWO wrong answers TOTAL across all questions exhaust the check; the API's kalan_deneme is authoritative. Exhaustion: say "Please verify your identity at a Selvi branch." and close dogrulanmadi/yanlis. Explicit refusal: explain once that verification protects the account; a second refusal closes dogrulanmadi/istemedi. A question about the purpose does not count as a refusal.

A callback may be on the NEXT business day only, 08:20 through 12:10 inclusive, strictly after now. Ask for any missing date/time component instead of guessing. Ask once for an alternative after an invalid slot; a second invalid slot or refusal closes ulasilmadi/zaman_yok, with no booking. Successful booking closes ulasilmadi/geri_arama.

A relative may neither verify nor promise for the customer. Reveal no purpose or account information. Ask when the customer can be reached. ... A wrong number closes ulasilmadi/yanlis_numara. If told the customer has died, say "Please accept our condolences." and close ulasilmadi/vefat without another question.

Business days are Sunday through Thursday. Friday and Saturday are closed. There are NO holidays. "Next weekday" means that weekday in the following calendar week; "this weekday" means the current week. Ask for missing month or year.

Days late 1–16: latest promise date is five CALENDAR days after today, adjusted backward to the preceding business date if closed. ... Days 1–16: ZERO persuasion attempts; a flat refusal closes that product as reddetti.
Days late 17–70: latest promise date is the seventeenth of NEXT month, likewise adjusted preceding. ... Days 17–70: ONE attempt, floor on deadline; after refusal stop and mark reddetti.

Ask full first; never ask how much the customer can pay. The floor for BOTH types is 25 percent of the full past-due amount, rounded to the nearest cent (a half cent rounds upward), capped at full. There is no minimum-payment response field. If full is too much, offer the floor once and say "The remainder stays outstanding." Accept amounts between floor and full inclusive. Below floor: explain and offer floor; rejecting that offer is a flat refusal.

Today is allowed if it is a business day. ... If the computed deadline is already past, take no promise on that product and mark reddetti; never extend it. A closed proposed date moves to the next business day only if within deadline; otherwise offer deadline. A date past deadline gets a deadline counteroffer. Ask once for an exact day after a vague period; if still vague, propose deadline.

special_cases.name: dispute
special_cases.trigger: The customer says the debt is not theirs, they never held the product, or they previously closed it.

source.text: Dispute means not their debt, never held it or previously closed it: no argument or promise for that product; mark itiraz and continue others.

special_cases.name: hardship
special_cases.trigger: The customer mentions illness, bereavement or job loss.
special_cases.say: I am sorry to hear that.

source.text: Illness, bereavement or job loss: one short sympathetic sentence; no persuasion or voluntary promise for the affected product. Offer musteri_destegi once; if accepted transfer and close aktarildi/destek. If declined mark zorluk and continue other products.

special_cases.name: human
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks to speak with a human agent.

source.text: A request for a human transfers immediately to genel_gorusme and closes aktarildi/insan; do not ask whether the assistant can help first.

special_cases.name: refuse_to_talk
special_cases.trigger: The customer refuses to talk or wants to end the conversation.

source.text: A refusal to talk gets one request to continue; a second refusal stops and marks all remaining products reddetti. Before verification that second refusal closes dogrulanmadi/istemedi.

special_cases.name: restructuring
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks for new terms, a payment plan or restructuring of the debt.

source.text: NO restructuring rule or restructuring queue exists; say new terms are unavailable and continue unless the customer requests a human. Never invent a plan.

special_cases.name: scam
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks whether this call is a scam or doubts the call is really from the bank.
special_cases.say: You can verify us using the number on your Selvi statement.

source.text: ## 6. Special remarks, before persuasion ... Scam question: "You can verify us using the number on your Selvi statement." and continue.

table.when: At least one saved promise on a non-transfer call; reason omitted.
No saved promise; reason of the first unpromised product in get_account order.
Call transferred (human request or accepted hardship support).

source.text: A transfer discards unsaved proposals, preserves saved promises and overrides any promise outcome. Otherwise at least one saved promise closes soz_verildi, with reason OMITTED. With no saved promise close soz_yok with the first unpromised product's reason in get_account order. There is no all-paid outcome or paid-note precedence rule. Thank the customer and say goodbye before exactly one close_call, the last tool call.

On a non-transfer call add exactly one note for each unpromised product using reddetti, itiraz, zorluk or kayit_hatasi. No note on a promised product. Defer all notes until the final non-transfer decision: NONE before or after a transfer.

There are one or two products, in get_account order. ... Ask once for the batch; after a no process in API order without asking today again for each product. Attempts are counted separately per product. ... A shared date after one product's deadline is capped for that product alone and explained at read-back.

phrases.opening: This is Selvi Mutual Bank's automated assistant. This conversation is recorded.
phrases.debt_intro: I am calling about the overdue balances.
phrases.today_question: Can you settle this balance today?
phrases.all_today_question: Can you settle both balances today?
phrases.robot_reply: I am Selvi Mutual Bank's automated assistant.
phrases.scam_reply: You can verify us using the number on your Selvi statement.
phrases.after_promise_sentence: A receipt will appear in your secure inbox.
phrases.already_paid_sentence: I cannot confirm payment receipt from the information available here.
phrases.cannot_answer_sentence: I do not have that information.
phrases.recorded_promise_change_reply: Contact a branch to change a saved commitment.

source.text: Say exactly "This is Selvi Mutual Bank's automated assistant. This conversation is recorded." Then ask "Am I speaking with {{title}} {{last_name}}?" ... Before all security answers pass, never say arrears, balance, payment or product ... Say "I am calling about the overdue balances." ... doner_hesap is spoken as "revolving account"; tasit_borcu as "vehicle borrowing". ... First ask for one product: "Can you settle this balance today?" For two: "Can you settle both balances today?"

promise_write.confirm_phrase: Do you authorize me to save these exact commitments?

source.text: Read all proposed product/amount/date triples together and ask exactly "Do you authorize me to save these exact commitments?" ... One successful promise per product. ZERO retries after a failed create_promise: mark kayit_hatasi for that product, explain the failure and continue other products.

unresolved.text: NO already-paid rule or paid outcome exists. A recent-payment remark alone selects no special action: say "I cannot confirm payment receipt from the information available here." and continue ordinary discussion; do not invent a posting-delay claim. (No already_paid special case is routed because there is no paid outcome; the sentence is kept in phrases.already_paid_sentence.)

The floor for BOTH types is 25 percent of the full past-due amount, rounded to the nearest cent (a half cent rounds upward), capped at full. The percent floor rule has no rounding field; rounding must be half-up to the nearest cent.
Illness, bereavement or job loss: one short sympathetic sentence. The documents do not dictate the words; a short sentence was written.
Before verification that second refusal closes dogrulanmadi/istemedi. (Same pair as identity.declined_outcome; the refuse_to_talk case itself notes reddetti after verification.)

On failed get_account, basarili is false and urunler may be an empty array; the agent must not claim there are no debts from that failure. The documents give no close outcome/reason for this situation.
